correctness.rationale: For each uniformly weighted clique the exact grounded inverse is (I+11^T/k)/(cm). Rank-one bridge updates produce three split-leader formulas. Cut-edge series resistance produces the two same-clique formulas and strict dominance of two non-gateway leaders. These five exhaustive orbits give global optimality including ties. Exact comparison J_SS-J_PG=q/t-alpha_p/(1+td_p), with alpha_p/d_p=(p+2)/4, proves strict impossibility when p<=4q-2; choosing alpha_p>alpha_q and t large proves sharp converse by comparing all limiting candidates and the first-order t^-1 term. The example has exactly checked crossings at 16/115 and 8/5. Standalone exact rational inversion passed 300 complete pair enumerations and 9000 inversions; finite tests are only corroboration.

value.rationale: Two-leader coherence design across a weighted intercommunity bottleneck is a natural optimal sensing/control model. The five-orbit exact minimizer replaces a quadratic candidate search and supports both exact tie and structural statements. The sharp parameter-independent four-to-one community-size threshold determines when colocation is even possible; a genuine two-transition example shows migration from split peripheral sensors to a gateway and eventually colocated sensors. This is not merely a numerical table, trivial substitution, or an isolated K2 special case.
